claims.citation: New York Herald, 19 July 1866, p. 8, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Steamship England (Br), Grace, Liverpool July 4, Queens-
town 5th, with mdse and 498[?] passengers, to the National
Steam Navigation Co. July 13, lat 43 50, lon 47 45, passed
steamship Wm Penn, hence for London; 15th, 4 AM, lat 43,
lon 42 30, passed bark Olbers (Brem), bound W; 16th, lat 41
38, lon 41, steamship Scotland, hence for Liverpool.
